text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while training for the autumn Tenno Sho…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Did you see this morning's news, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Every year around this time, they release a list of everyone who has announced their intent to race in the Senior Autumn Triple Crown races.
choice_data_list: Now you know who you're up against in each race.
Now you know who you're up against in each race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …It doesn't matter who I'm racing. I plan to take first regardless.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That said, I'm not so conceited as to overlook this information.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Going forward, we should take our opponents into account during training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I check all of the materials we have on hand in order to formulate a strategy to handle Narita Brian's rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: According to the list, Hishi Amazon—who made a fierce showing at the Arima Kinen—has announced her intent to run in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She'll undoubtedly be stronger now than she was at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And as for the upcoming autumn Tenno Sho…

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Hey, looks like this one should be in the bag! You're competing against that Matikanetannhauser, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Matikanetannhauser. You could say she's someone people can't stop talking about, in a sense.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite having ample strength to win G1 races, various factors seem to always align and prevent her from winning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The stars seemed to have finally aligned for her at last year's Arima Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But then she apparently got sick right before and couldn't even run.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: If that's who she's up against, Narita Brian should have no problem.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: You're running in the Japan Cup, right? If so, you ought to just focus your efforts on dealing with that "Queen of the Amazons" there.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Sheesh, you're too by the book. You're going to tire yourself out if you don't catch what breaks you can.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Not to mention, you both seem to be making a big fuss about this "sisterly showdown," but the truth is that the media expects Biwa Hayahide to dr—

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: H-hey! Where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the training course, Narita Brian has just finished her warm-up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm ready to go anytime, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian is a racer who has a head-on approach to running. Surely, the autumn Tenno Sho will be no exception…
choice_data_list: You're taking the autumn Tenno Sho seriously, right?
You're taking the autumn Tenno Sho seriously, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Only racing can satisfy this craving in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: And this is the Twinkle Series—there's no time to cut corners.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: There's no such thing as an easy opponent, so I always take my races seriously.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's the matter? We don't have time to sit around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Narita Brian runs training drills repeatedly in preparation for the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Is this everything?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Sis?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Why aren't you wearing your uniform? Today's a weekday.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …There's no training today, so I'm going out.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: By the way, it makes me proud to see you working so hard every day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Don't talk like it has nothing to do with you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm planning on surpassing you, so you better be ready.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …I'm already one of many behind you, looking at your back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Come again?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian, just keep on running ahead. Don't ever look back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Sis?
